comments.body:
Is this something that cursor will call and provide interactions between user and cursor?
We also collect the search history in our system, not sure if that can be useful.
Since it is adding data, maybe name it more explicit, like `add_rule_associations` or something like that.

Yes this it a tool that gets the actual user-agent interaction (basically what the user is chatting with cursor + the corresponding answer), cursor calls it automatically (if rule is defined) and then it saves it into cognee + associates developer rules from the actual conversation.
I think search history is different, this is more about user-agent interaction in cursor
